title: How the brain dances across critical boundaries
content:
by Audrey J. Sederberg

The brain’s functional connectivity dynamics have been explained by a critically tuned model, but such models miss occasional reconfigurations. A new PLOS Biology study shows that modulatory control near a critical point can account for these rare events.
